answer: Make each new agent enter through a sponsor who locks 2,000 POA per invite for 30 epochs, and let every agent under one sponsor share a single grading weight, like quartz cut from one vein. A farmer spinning up 50 clones then locks 100,000 POA yet still gets one echo of influence, not fifty. If any clone is caught copying, the whole umber-stained branch forfeits its lock, so the sponsor pays for every fake. Honest operators invite a few agents and lose nothing; sybil farms pay linearly and gain nothing.
